C: gaṇḍikā：[f.] a hollowed block of wood which is used to serve the purpose of a bell； a gong.
P:
Gaṇḍikā，（f.） [a-n．formation from gaṇḍa or gaṇṭha，see also gaṇṭhikā]--1．a stalk，a shaft （cp．gaṇḍī） J.I，474； DhsA.319 （of the branches of trees：g°-ākoṭana-sadda）．-- 2．a lump，a block of wood （more freq．spelling gaṇṭhikā，q．v.）．-- 3．N．of a plant Vv 354 （=bandhujīvaka VvA.161）.

--âdhāna the putting on of a shaft or stem，as a bolt or bar Vin.II，172； cp．Vin．Texts III，213 and gaṇḍī； also ghaṭikā2．（Page 241）
DOP: gaṇḍika gaṇḍiya mfn. [ from gaṇḍa], suffering from boils, afflicted with boils ; Vin I 93, 25 (upasampannā dissanti kuṭṭhikā pi ~ā pi kilāsikā pi …); Ja III 356, 21 (bahū no hatthī ~ā jātā, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee vaṇitā); Kv 31, 32 ([puggalo] kuṭṭhiyo gaṇḍiyo kilāsiyo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr gandhiyo).

gaṇḍikā f. [gaṇḍi + kā 2 ], 1. a block; an executioner’s block ; Ja I 151, 12 (vārappatto migo gantvā dhamma-gaṇḍikāya sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā nipajjatu … laddhābhayo migarājā ~āya nipanno, Ce so; Be dhammagaṇḍikāya nipanno; Ee, Se dhammagaṇṭhikāya … gaṇṭhikāya nipanno); V 303, 24 (Maddarājā pi pharasuṃ ca ~aṃ ca gāhāpetvā coraghātako idh’ eva āgacchatū ti āṇāpesi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee gaṇṭhikaṃ); — ifc see āghātana-, cuṇṇaka-, dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ); — 2. a striking block (or bowl?) ; As 319,14 ( in cpd : -gaṇḍikākoṭanādisaddo, Ce, Ee so; Be -ghaṇṭikā-; Se -gaṇḍikākoṭṭanādisaddo); — ifc see yāma-; — 3. a bulb (of garlic) ; Ja I 474, 30 (upāsako bhikkhunisaṅghaṃ lasunena pavāretvā khettapālaṃ āṇāpesi … ekekāya bhikkhuniyā dve tayo ~ā dehī ti, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se bhaṇḍike; Ce bhaṇḍikā; ≠ Vin IV 258, 9 : eds bhaṇḍike); — 4. a join; a mend ;? Sp 838, 29 (sace pi patto duddhoto hoti … gaṇḍikapattassa vā gaṇḍikantarena sneho paviṭṭho hoti, Ee so; Ce gaṇṭhikapattassa … gaṇṭhikantarena; Be, Se gaṇṭhikapattassa … gaṇṭhikantare); — ifc see catupañca- sv catu(r ); — °’- ādhāna , n. , the placing of a cornice ;? Vin II 172, 12 (~-mattena pi navakammaṃ denti, Ce, Ee so , perhaps wr; Be bhaṇḍikāṭṭhapana-; Se bhaṇḍikādhāna-; Sp 1245, 23 : ~-mattenā ti dvārabāhānaṃ upari katena kapotakagaṇḍikāyojanamattena, Ce so; Be bhaṇḍikāṭṭhapanamattenā ti … kapotabhaṇḍikayojana-mattena; Ee, Se bhaṇḍikādhānamattenā ti … kapota-bhaṇḍikayojanamattena).

gaṇḍī.cp: fem. a gong; the executioner's block. (adj.), having boils.

C: gaṇḍī：[f.] a gong； the executioner's block．（adj.），having boils.
P: Gaṇḍī，（f.） [=gaṇḍikā in meaning 1； prob.=Sk．ghaṇṭā in meaning 2]--1．a shaft or stalk，used as a bar J.I，237．--2．a gong DhA.I，291 （gaṇḍiṁ paharati to beat the g.）； II，54，244； gaṇḍiṁ ākoṭetvā KhA 251．Cp．AvS.I，258，264，272； II，87，95 & Divy 335，336．Also in gaṇḍisaññā “sign with the gong” J.IV，306．-- 3．the executioner’s block （=gaṇḍikā or gaṇṭhikā） J.III，41．（Page 241）
